responsibility: This C-family target helper file defines the preprocessor builtins exposed by the GCC eBPF port. Through the TARGET_CPU_CPP_BUILTINS hook it emits architecture, endianness, CPU-version, and ISA-feature macros such as __BPF_CPU_VERSION__ and __BPF_FEATURE_* based on the selected BPF ISA and enabled target options, so front ends and user headers can condition compilation on backend-visible BPF capabilities.
